Circular Modular Network Coupled with Environmental Correlation Heatmaps

Source: R/type_env_network.R
type_env_network.Rd

Creates publication-ready multi-domain integration networks coupling a central modular microbial/omics co-occurrence network with peripheral triangular correlation heatmaps of environmental, clinical, or host-associated indicators (e.g. soil chemistry across seasons, clinical biomarkers across cohorts, or multi-tissue traits). Curved inter-domain links connect environmental indicators from the triangular diagonal to central network modules, weighted by statistical significance and colored by correlation direction.

Usage

type_env_network(
  env_cors = NULL,
  links = NULL,
  comm_data = NULL,
  module_colors = NULL,
  corner_palettes = NULL,
  link_colors = c(Positive = "#E64B35", Negative = "#4DBBD5"),
  show_asterisks = TRUE,
  show_values = FALSE,
  show_cor = NULL,
  label_type = c("auto", "stars", "coef", "coef_stars", "none"),
  value_digits = 2,
  value_size = NULL,
  compact = TRUE,
  show_module_labels = TRUE,
  module_labels = NULL,
  module_label_size = 2.4,
  module_label_color = "grey15",
  module_label_fill = "white",
  module_label_bg = TRUE,
  module_label_alpha = 1,
  module_label_pos = c("radial", "centroid"),
  show_module_legend = TRUE,
  legend_position = "top",
  show_domain_labels = TRUE,
  env_label_size = 1.95,
  env_label_color = "grey20",
  env_label_face = "plain",
  link_width_range = c(0.4, 1.4),
  link_width = NULL,
  link_alpha = 0.7,
  show_link_values = FALSE,
  link_value_size = 2,
  link_value_digits = 2,
  circle_radius = 2.8,
  circle_width = 0.4,
  circle_color = "grey65",
  circle_linetype = "dashed",
  outer_ring_size = 0.6,
  outer_ring_color = "grey60",
  outer_ring_alpha = 0.6,
  intra_edge_width = 0.18,
  intra_edge_color = "grey82",
  intra_edge_alpha = 0.35,
  diag_point_size = 2,
  diag_point_fill = "#F781BF",
  diag_point_color = "#C51B7D",
  node_size_range = c(1.1, 3.8),
  hull_alpha = 0.18,
  curvature = 0.14,
  preset = c("default", "nature", "clinical", "seasonal", "cell", "dark", "lancet",
    "minimal", "multi_tissue", "pharmacology", "circadian", "diurnal", "bipolar",
    "response"),
  style = NULL,
  scifig = FALSE,
  title = NULL
)

Arguments

env_cors

Named list of 1 to 4 correlation matrices for corner triangular heatmaps. Names define corner labels (e.g. list("Env 1" = cor1, "Env 2" = cor2)).

links

Optional data frame of links connecting environmental variables to network modules. Required columns: env, module, r, and p (or log10p). If NULL, significant links are computed or sampled automatically from input data.

module_colors

Optional named vector of colors for network modules.

corner_palettes

Optional list of color vectors for the corner heatmaps.

link_colors

Named vector of colors for link signs (default c("Positive" = "#E64B35", "Negative" = "#4DBBD5")).

show_asterisks

Logical. If TRUE, overlays significance asterisks (*, **, ***) in correlation tiles. Default TRUE.

show_values

Logical. If TRUE, displays numerical correlation values in correlation tiles. Default FALSE.

show_cor

Logical alias for show_values. If non-NULL, overrides show_values.

label_type

Character string specifying tile annotation format: "auto" (default, determined by show_values and show_asterisks), "coef" (e.g. ".42"), "coef_stars" (e.g. ".42***"), "stars" (e.g. "***"), or "none".

value_digits

Integer number of decimal places for correlation coefficients (default 2).

value_size

Optional numeric font size for tile text. If NULL (default), automatically calculated based on tile step dimensions so numbers fit inside without clipping.

compact

Logical. If TRUE (default), strips leading zeros (e.g. ".42" instead of "0.42") for compact, high-density tile fitting.

show_module_labels

Logical. If TRUE (default), displays text labels for modules/components inside the central circle.

module_labels

Optional named character vector or list mapping module IDs (e.g. "Mod_1") to custom display labels (e.g. c("Mod_1" = "M1: S. aureus core")).

module_label_size

Numeric font size for module labels inside the circle (default 2.4).

module_label_color

Color of module label text and borders (default "grey15").

module_label_fill

Background fill color for module labels (default "white").

module_label_bg

Logical. If TRUE (default), renders labels inside rounded opaque badges.

module_label_alpha

Numeric fill transparency for module label badges (default 1.0, fully opaque).

module_label_pos

Placement of module labels: "radial" (default, placed radially outward toward the circle boundary to avoid overlapping dense core nodes) or "centroid" (placed directly at module centroid).

show_module_legend

Logical. If TRUE, shows the module color legend. Default TRUE.

legend_position

Position of the legend: "top" (default), "bottom", "right", "left", or "none".

show_domain_labels

Logical. If TRUE, displays domain headers for the corner heatmaps. Default TRUE.

env_label_size

Font size for environmental variable labels outside corner heatmaps (default 1.95).

env_label_color

Text color for environmental variable labels (default "grey20").

env_label_face

Font face for environmental variable labels (default "plain").

link_width_range

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying line width range for inter-domain curved links scaled by significance (default c(0.4, 1.4)).

link_width

Optional numeric constant line width for inter-domain links. If non-NULL, overrides link_width_range.

link_alpha

Transparency for inter-domain curved links (default 0.70).

show_link_values

Logical. If TRUE, displays numerical correlation coefficients on the curved inter-domain links (default FALSE).

link_value_size

Font size for correlation digits on inter-domain links (default 2.0).

link_value_digits

Integer number of decimal places for link correlation digits (default 2).

circle_radius

Numeric radius of the central boundary circle (default 2.80).

circle_width

Line width of the central boundary circle (default 0.4).

circle_color

Line color of the central boundary circle (default "grey65").

circle_linetype

Linetype of the central boundary circle (default "dashed").

outer_ring_size

Size of dots along the outer boundary circle (default 0.6).

outer_ring_color

Color of dots along the outer boundary circle (default "grey60").

outer_ring_alpha

Transparency of dots along the outer boundary circle (default 0.6).

intra_edge_width

Line width of intra-module network edges (default 0.18).

intra_edge_color

Color of intra-module network edges (default "grey82").

intra_edge_alpha

Transparency of intra-module network edges (default 0.35).

diag_point_size

Size of diagonal indicator connector points on heatmaps (default 2.0).

diag_point_fill

Fill color of diagonal indicator points (default "#F781BF").

diag_point_color

Border color of diagonal indicator points (default "#C51B7D").

node_size_range

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying size range for network nodes (default c(1.1, 3.8)).

hull_alpha

Shading transparency for module cluster hulls (default 0.18).

curvature

Numeric curvature of inter-domain connecting lines (default 0.14).

preset

Character string specifying publisher style preset: "default", "nature", "clinical", "seasonal", "cell", "dark", "lancet", "minimal", "multi_tissue" (or "pharmacology"), "circadian" (or "diurnal"), or "bipolar" (or "response").

style

Character string alias for preset. If supplied, overrides preset.

scifig

Logical. If TRUE, enforces AI4SciFig publication gates (font floor >= 5 pt, line floor >= 0.25 pt, zero sign suppression, and CVD compliant palettes).

title

Optional plot title.

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.
